desc:
🏎️ Welcome to a Blocky F1 Racing Experience!

Race around high-speed circuits with realistic F1-inspired handling, precision cornering, tire grip, braking, acceleration, and intense wheel-to-wheel battles.

But be careful—crashes are fully destructive. Hit the barriers, spin out, flip through the air, and watch your car break apart piece by piece!

Player vs Player Collisions are enabled during the race, but disabled during the qualifying!

This game is a bit intensive. PC is recommended although I tried optimizing as best as I could for mobile. 

Make sure to leave feedback, I try to read them everyday 

🔥 Features:
• 8 unique F1 race cars
• 24 different liveries
• 3 Maps With More Coming
• Realistic racing handling, Crash physics and vehicle destruction
• RACE VS AI: no one online? Take on a full grid of AI drivers.
• TIME TRIAL: race your own ghost and beat your best lap.
• WEEKLY CHALLENGE: set the fastest lap of the week. The top 3 on each track win an exclusive livery.
